The '''1964–65 season''' was '''[[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol]]'s''' [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|62nd season]] in existence and the club's [[La Liga records and statistics#All-time La Liga table|33rd consecutive season]] in the top flight of Spanish football.

==Summary==
The club clinched its 11th League title<ref>{{cite web|publisher=Diario Marca|title=La flor del Real Madrid Yé-yé|url=http://www.marca.com/2011/07/07/futbol/mas_futbol/1310030818.html?a=d4b430a7096e9c1309423dd461d4cc04&t=1354897168|access-date=7 December 2019}}</ref>
four points above runners-up [[Atlético Madrid]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.elmundo.es/elmundodeporte/especiales/2002/02/centenario/1955.html |title=Historia del Real Madrid, 100 años uno a uno|publisher=Diario El Mundo|access-date=7 December 2019}}</ref> and five championship in a row a record remained until 1990 when the club won again the same consecutive trophies. Defensive line was crucial for the title allowing only 18 goals against, instead of an attacking style played by the team in last seasons. New Spanish arrivals for the squad were taking form into the club: from [[UD Las Palmas]] goalkeeper [[Antonio Betancort]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Real legend Antonio Betancort dies|url=http://www.marca.com/en/2015/03/15/en/football/real_madrid/1426420170.html|website=Marca|location=Spain|access-date=16 March 2015}}</ref> from [[Granada CF]] 19-yrs-old midfielder Pirri (playing his match debut in the campaign against [[FC Barcelona]] replacing suspended Puskas),<ref>{{cite news|url=https://as.com/futbol/2014/11/08/primera/1415417737_782789.html|title=Hoy se cumplen cincuenta años del debut de Pirri de blanco|trans-title=Fifty years from Pirri white debut|newspaper=[[Diario AS]]|first=Carmen|last=Colino|language=es|date=8 November 2014|access-date=11 September 2017}}</ref> forwards Grosso, Serena (replacing ageing Puskas) and youngstar defender Manuel Sanchis.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://deportes.elpais.com/deportes/2014/11/09/actualidad/1415551382_322979.html|publisher=Diario El País|access-date=10 November 2019|title=Amancio convierte a Puskas en suplente}}</ref>

In Copa del Generalísimo, the club was eliminated by [[Atlético Madrid]] in the round of 16 after a 0–4 away defeat. Meanwhile, in the European Cup the squad was reached the quarter-finals where it defeated by Portuguese side [[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]] 3–6 on aggregate (including a 1–5 loss in Lisbon).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.record.pt/futebol/futebol-nacional/liga-nos/benfica/detalhe/aguias-foram-ao-cinema-e-colocaram-real-madrid-num-filme-de-terror|title=Goleada 5–1|publisher=record.pt|language=Portuguese}}</ref>
